title: 如念
description: 作品的一个前瞻，也算是特别篇

en.title: Ru Nian
en.description: A preview of the story, also serving as a special episode.

readingGuide.genre: 修仙 · 情感 · 特别篇
readingGuide.relation: 《如念》是同一故事的特别篇，围绕池玉婉与叶天丘的思念和重逢展开；《天人合一·前传》从更早的事件讲起。
readingGuide.order: 想按故事发生的先后了解人物，可以先读《天人合一·前传》；也可以独立阅读《如念》，先感受人物之间的情感。

en.relation: Ru Nian is a special episode in the same story, following Chi Yuwan and Ye Tianqiu through longing and reunion. The prequel begins with earlier events.
en.order: For the earlier events, start with the prequel. Ru Nian can also be read independently as an introduction to the characters’ relationships.
